findings.summary: Reader source-info redefines the shared RFC3986 segment escaping policy.
findings.consequence: Future changes to path segment escaping can drift between Reader source-info validation, sanitizer URL rewriting, canonical reader resolver paths, manifest client paths, and app navigation helpers. The current callers validate or bound inputs before encoding, so this is a maintainability risk rather than a confirmed runtime defect.
findings.evidence: The owned helper at lines 200-205 applies encodeURIComponent plus the RFC3986 replacement for [!'()*]. The same escaping body is already present in shared/utils/route-segment.ts as encodeValidatedRouteSegment, and equivalent local helpers are used by server/api/reader/resolve/[author]/[title].get.ts, server/utils/work-manifest-client.ts, server/utils/reader-source.ts, and app/lib/internal-navigation.ts.
findings.recommendation: Replace this helper body with a shared import, preferably by reusing shared/utils/route-segment.ts#encodeValidatedRouteSegment or extracting the percent-escape step into one app/server-safe URL utility while keeping validSegment as this module's validation boundary.
